rationale: Both validate the diagram thoroughly and sort a copy of the children. B computes each child's four plants once in NewGarden and stores them in a map, so Plants reduces to a lookup. B also checks that the diagram has enough cups for all the children, a robustness check that A lacks. If there are more children than cups, A's Plants would index out of range and panic. A keeps redundant state (a children slice plus an index map) where the slice is never used after construction. B is simpler and safer.
